_about: Ground truth for scripts/eval_triage.py, keyed by failure family. Severity = the family's base incident. Each key fact is something a correct root cause must say; keywords are lowercase substrings the free keyword judge looks for (any one matches). The Claude judge reads the fact text, not the keywords.

key_facts.fact: the connection pool is exhausted
connections/sessions are leaked or not returned (not closed)
the billing address is null/missing for some customers
code assumes the field is always present instead of null-checking it
the container exceeded its memory limit
the kernel OOM killer terminated it (exit 137)
package.json and package-lock.json are out of sync
the regenerated lockfile was not committed after a dependency change
a Redis/ElastiCache failover moved the primary
the client points at a fixed node IP/host instead of the primary endpoint DNS name
the TLS certificate has expired
renewal was missed/not automated
a promise was not awaited/caught, producing an unhandled rejection
the unhandled rejection crashes the Node process
the disk is full
Docker images/build cache accumulate without pruning
the Terraform state lock is held
a previous run was killed/interrupted and never released it (stale lock)
processing between polls exceeds max.poll.interval.ms
consumers are removed from the group, causing repeated rebalances
a write to a nil (uninitialised) map
the map is only initialised on some code paths (e.g. when config has the block)
a timezone mismatch: local time vs UTC
the test is flaky/fails only at certain times of day
the bucket uses SSE-KMS with a KMS key
the role lacks KMS permissions on that key (e.g. kms:GenerateDataKey/Decrypt)
a deadlock between the migration and live traffic
the migration took heavy locks on a hot table (e.g. non-concurrent index / ALTER)
the function hit the Lambda timeout
an outbound HTTP call has no client timeout and hangs on a slow partner/upstream
a value is possibly undefined/null under strict null checks
a type change (upgraded types/API client) made the field optional
the GitHub API rate limit was exceeded
too many API calls (one per item, retries)
tasks run longer than the broker's visibility_timeout
unacknowledged tasks are redelivered and run twice
WAL accumulated and filled the disk
an abandoned/inactive replication slot prevents WAL from being recycled
the liveness probe kills the pod before startup finishes
the app starts slower than the probe's initial delay/failure budget
Postgres max_connections is exceeded
pods x pool size opens more connections than allowed (scale-out)
the query exceeds statement_timeout
a missing index causes a sequential scan on a large table
Redis reached maxmemory and rejects writes
keys have no TTL and/or the eviction policy is noeviction
a slow O(N) command (e.g. KEYS) blocked Redis
Redis is single-threaded so other clients time out
the image tag does not exist in the registry
the image build/push step failed or was skipped before deploy
a required env var (e.g. DATABASE_URL) is missing
the Secret/ConfigMap supplying it is absent in the namespace
pods are unschedulable due to insufficient CPU
the cluster/node group cannot scale up (at autoscaler max) or requests are too high
the JVM ran out of heap space
an unbounded cache/map without eviction keeps growing
the Node build exceeds the default V8 heap limit
it's a large production build (bundle/source maps) on CI
a peer dependency conflict (ERESOLVE)
a package only supports an older major version of the upgraded framework (e.g. React)
the certificate's hostname/SAN does not match the requested name
the hostname/domain changed but the certificate wasn't reissued
the internal/root CA is not trusted in the runtime
the base image changed and lacks the CA bundle/certificates
an explicit deny in the bucket policy
the request doesn't come through the required VPC endpoint (aws:SourceVpce)
temporary AWS credentials/session token expired
credentials are fetched once and not refreshed during a long-running job
writes are throttled on DynamoDB
a poorly distributed partition key concentrates traffic on one hot partition
partition leadership moved (broker restart/leader election)
the producer does not retry (retries=0), so messages are dropped
a nil pointer dereference of the HTTP response
resp.Body.Close is deferred / resp used before checking err
concurrent writes to a map from multiple goroutines
no synchronisation (mutex / sync.Map)
conflicting provider version constraints
a module requires a newer major provider than the root pins
GITHUB_TOKEN lacks write permission (403 / resource not accessible)
the workflow needs an explicit permissions block
the base image tag no longer exists / can't be pulled
the base OS/distribution (e.g. buster) reached end of life
the test database can't be dropped because it's still in use
connections are left open after teardown (e.g. a background thread)
an unpinned transitive dependency was upgraded (markupsafe)
the new version removed an API the old library uses (soft_unicode)
a worker process was killed by SIGKILL / the OOM killer
combined memory of concurrent workers exceeds the container limit
DNS lookups are failing/timing out in the cluster
ndots:5 search-domain expansion multiplies queries and overloads CoreDNS
the Lambda ran out of memory
